text:
Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — Blueforge accepted a preview seat for our private deployment next week. Need to lock onboarding timeline and capture feedback cadence. Anyone available for a 15m sync today?

Diego (CSE): @Maya congrats! I can do 3pm PT. Onboarding checklist: api keys, VPC peering, sample dataset ingest. I'll start a runbook.

Aria (PM): 3pm works. Can we prioritize demo of the session-estimation feature? Blueforge said latency is a blocker for one of their ML flows.

Liam (Eng): noted. I'll validate model routing & burst policy config. Might need a short dev spike to increase cache TTLs.

OnboardingBot: Invite sent to blueforge_cx@blueforge.com for Tue 2025-05-13 15:00 PT — join link: https://meet.redwood.ai/abcd1234

Maya (CS): Diego — can you post the enrollment email copy in this thread? Aria — can you prepare 3 quick questions for the feedback survey? I want a minimal NPS + one product-signal + one onboarding signal.

Diego (CSE): Copy below — feel free to tweak.
```
Subject: Welcome to Redwood Preview — Blueforge seat confirmed
Hi <FirstName>,

Thanks for joining the preview. Next steps:
1) Confirm meeting: {{meet_link}}
2) Share a small sample dataset (s3 link) for ingest
3) Flag any compliance reqs

See you at the kickoff. — Diego
```

Aria (PM): Survey draft: 1) How well did the onboarding cover your primary use case? (1-5)
2) Any latency issues observed during the test runs? (free text)
3) How likely to continue after preview? (0-10)

Maya (CS): Perfect. Action items:
- Diego: send email + runbook by EOD (owner)
- Liam: smoke test routing + share perf numbers before kickoff
- Aria: final survey, add to meeting agenda
- Maya: send calendar invite to exec sponsor and CS playbook

Diego (CSE): Sending email now. :outbox_tray: 

Liam (Eng): Running smoke tests, will post results here in ~45m.

Maya (CS): If any renewal-risk flags (engagement <3 after survey or perf >1.5x target), we'll open a follow-up remediation sprint. Thanks all :thumbsup:
